# SM1 Part A - OVERLAPS_ALPHA (1b-8; generated by run.py; do not edit by hand)

C_alpha(a, b -> c) = int psi_a psi_b conj(psi_c) dA / (|psi_a| |psi_b| |psi_c|), dA = alpha sin(theta) dtheta dphi (unit radius). Sections are the E4 forms [Venus]: psi_s = (alpha sin theta)^(-s) tan(theta/2)^((m - q)/alpha) sin(theta)^(q/alpha) e^{i m phi}, m in Z + s, q = N/2. A section of negative charge is taken as conj(psi_{-q,-s,-m}) [build interpretation: the E4 form with q < 0 has no regular modes]. Labels are (N, s, m) with N = 2q signed. Selection rules: m_c = m_a + m_b and s_a + s_b = s_c (counting the conjugate). Closed form: Beta functions (mpmath, 40 digits); quadrature: Gauss-Legendre in t = ln tan(theta/2), 2000 nodes on [-40, 40] (check column: 4000 nodes).

Values are given for the alpha grid; the alpha_ext column is added only when the 0.2 slot holds it.
